summary: Implement canonical product-compliance evidence, versioned policy evaluation, registry-verification/expiry ports, and a host-side fail-closed publication guard before connector products.write execution.

impacts.evidence: Compliance documents, bindings, policies and verification facts are organization/workspace scoped, use composite tenant references, transaction-local scope and forced RLS; subject and holder guards reject cross-tenant canonical references.

Compliance evidence can contain regulated business identifiers. Audit/outbox/lineage store bounded ids/status/version rather than registry payloads; public evaluation is no-store and evidence object content remains outside this task pending upload-security controls.
An additive POST /compliance/evaluate operation and new Draft 2020-12 v2/evaluation schemas are added. Existing product-compliance v1 and document-status event contracts remain byte-identical.
New compliance.product.record_changed.v1 is additive and emitted through the existing transactional outbox. Existing compliance event v1 is unchanged.

Connector SDK root interfaces remain unchanged; Task-029 host sandbox gains an additive OperationGuard and products.write now fails closed unless host compliance authorization succeeds before executor or egress.
Expand migration 000017 adds compliance documents, bindings, policies and verification history with indexes/RLS/guards and no destructive rename/drop of existing schema.

Publication enforcement runs host-side before connector execution/network; missing guard denies products.write. PostgreSQL rejects invalid/cross-tenant product, offer, category, GTIN and SKU bindings and blocks hard deletion of evidence.
Policy outcomes are allow/warn/approval_required/block. approval_required can proceed only through an injected Task-017 authorizer; block and evaluation errors fail closed.
Every compliance repository mutation atomically records Task-003 Audit, Task-008 Outbox and Task-030 Lineage evidence with exact tenant/resource/version identity.
Versioned policies, immutable verification facts and deterministic evaluation/expiry fingerprints make retries reproducible; repository writes use optimistic versions and canonical evidence ids.

Task 082 adds no direct provider network path. Official-registry verification is exposed only as a provider-neutral port, while connector products.write egress remains mediated by the Task-029 sandbox after compliance authorization.
Evaluation queries are bounded/indexed, return explainable reason codes and evidence ids, and preserve correlation through audit/outbox/lineage. Runtime SLO thresholds remain Task 066.
Migration is expand-only. Binary rollback leaves compliance evidence and policy history intact; tenancy and backup/PITR rehearsals are extended to qualify preservation.
Tests cover policy outcomes, verification/expiry rules, GTIN/SKU scoping, host no-bypass before executor/egress, migration guards, tenant isolation, contracts and trusted-base architecture admission.
